sections.title: Pros
sections.narration: The upsides first: beta-carotene is the signature upside. The orange flesh gives sweet potato a clear carotenoid identity. Better fibre support than many tubers. The fibre helps the carb package look more useful. Naturally sweet without added sugar. It brings sweetness without needing a processed dessert format.

sections.title: Cons
sections.narration: The drawbacks next: glycemic impact changes with cooking method. Baking, boiling, cooling, and mashing can change the real-world carb behaviour. Large portions push carbs up fast. It is still a starchy tuber, so the carb load can climb quickly. Protein is barely part of the case. The tuber job is energy and carotenoids, not meaningful protein.
